originalDoneWhen: Eva blijft op ongepaste momenten stil; gezin beoordeelt nut en hinder apart.
result: Ongevraagde gedeelde berichten volgen nu dezelfde actuele voorgrondcontrole als de bestaande initiatiefafweging, ook na de laatste duurzame broncontrole. De bestaande nachtrust 22:00–08:00 Europe/Amsterdam blijft behouden. Nut, hinder en timing blijven afzonderlijk beoordeeld.
existing: Existing initiative planner, durable store, household delivery, authority and quiet-time window.
Genuine separated owner feedback already recorded in HUE5; no replay of closed HUE5/HUE6 trials.

changes.change: Apply the existing current foreground callback to the existing delivery window after authority validation.
Recheck the current attention window after final durable provenance authorization immediately before an unsolicited HTTP offer.

usage.note: Counts concern this bounded verification; ordinary Eva runtime usage and Codex development usage are separate. Unknown credits are not estimated.

limitations: Foreground means an in-flight runtime conversation, not arbitrary household busyness or sleeping detection.
The installed probe used real composition with isolated output/store boundaries; no physical household announcement was sent and no actual sleeping/busy family was observed.
Existing owner feedback belongs only to its original contribution: utility not useful for this owner, timing appropriate and not intrusive. It is not positive acceptance of all initiatives.
A final check and external HTTP operation cannot form an atomic transaction; no absolute elimination of every concurrent interruption is claimed.
Repeated spontaneous household value and full family acceptance remain open under the existing final acceptance tasks.
